research_summary: The pre-deadline search found no new confirmed absence among the carried GW12 fork squad. It found a positive but uncertain Semenyo availability update and continuing expert concern about Gabriel, who had already been sold by the fork.

sources.title: Who could be returning?
sources.citation_excerpt: For Bournemouth Andoni Iraola is hopeful Antoine Semenyo will be available.
sources.claim_text: Bournemouth manager Andoni Iraola was hopeful that Antoine Semenyo would be available for GW13.

sources.title: My favourite of the lot is Nico O'Reilly
sources.citation_excerpt: Gabriel's injury may not be long-term; however, we are in a time when games come thick and fast. GW13-15 all happen in the space of 9 days. With that in mind, I'd say Gabriel is a sell.
sources.claim_text: The expert assessment treated Gabriel's injury as sufficiently material in the congested schedule to recommend selling him for GW13.
